title: ProofScope
description: The inputs a verdict is a function of (ARCHITECTURE.md 2 axiom 1, 5). FROZEN. The SHA-256 of this record is the proof key; it therefore carries neither run_id nor its own hash. A field is null when the phase that binds it has not run: null means 'not yet bound', never 'bound to nothing'.

repo_sha.description: Git HEAD of the scanned tree, or null when the target is not a git repository. The tree_hash binds the content either way.

tree_hash.description: SHA-256 over the sorted (path, blob hash) pairs of the whole source closure. Always present, git or not.

dependency_resolution_hash.description: SHA-256 over the resolved dependency set. Null only when no dependency resolution was attempted.

provider_contract_hash.description: Hash of the Change Pack the verdict is bound to (Phase 2).

rules_hash.description: Hash of the pack rule set used by the structure observer (Phase 3).

scanner_version.description: Version of hubbleops and of every external binary whose output entered the scan. A tool upgrade changes the scope, and therefore kills the proof.
